CHECK (
CASE kind
    WHEN 'extend'::text THEN ((days IS NOT NULL) AND (last_day IS NULL) AND (target_op IS NULL) AND (based_on IS NULL) AND (resolution IS NULL))
    WHEN 'set'::text THEN ((days IS NULL) AND (target_op IS NULL) AND (based_on IS NOT NULL) AND (resolution IS NULL))
    WHEN 'undo'::text THEN ((days IS NULL) AND (last_day IS NULL) AND (target_op IS NOT NULL) AND (target_op <> op_id) AND (based_on IS NULL) AND (resolution IS NULL))
    WHEN 'resolve'::text THEN ((days IS NULL) AND (last_day IS NULL) AND (target_op IS NOT NULL) AND (target_op <> op_id) AND (based_on IS NULL) AND (resolution IS NOT NULL))
    ELSE false
END)
